Hi Kimberly / Jordan,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. To get Redwood set up in our AP system and ensure POs route correctly, we need the following information back from your side by end of day Friday: 

- Completed AP vendor packet (attached): legal company name, primary remit address, bank remit instructions (currency per bank), VAT / GST IDs for all trading entities.
- Copy of tax form (US W-9 or EU VAT certificate)
- Sample invoice PDF and a mapping table showing where you expect PO fields to appear on your invoices (PO number, PO line, PO item description, unit price, tax keys).
- Confirmation whether Redwood will accept split invoices by PO line (Y/N) and whether partial shipments are expected.
- A sample PO (we prefer JSON or CSV) so our system can be validated.
- AP cutoff times for processing (we need to know payment terms to set up auto-pay).

I've attached our basic packet (Acme_AP_vendor_packet.pdf) — please complete pages 1-3 and return. If you have any questions on the mapping table, loop in your finance lead.

Liam O'Connor

2) Tax form: attaching Redwood_W9.pdf.

Please confirm whether your system requires the PO number in the invoice filename or only in an invoice header field.

I've attached our vendor profile spreadsheet and the signed W-9. For the mapping table, see tab "PO_map" in Redwood_vendor_profile.xlsx — it lists our invoice fields and suggested corresponding PO attributes. Please review and confirm the required field names so we can produce sample invoices that validate against your ingestion rules.

Thanks Kim — that's perfect and very helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- PO placement: our ingestion prefers PO number in the invoice header (field name: "PO_NUMBER") and we'll also accept PO in the filename but the header field is required for automated matching.
- PO-line id: please include the PO line id in the CSV/line detail column labeled "PO_LINE_ID". If that column is absent we will fall back to line description matching which increases manual review.
- Split invoices: we support split invoices by PO line; our portal requires a boolean flag "SPLIT_BY_LINE" in the metadata (true/false).
- Tax: for EU VAT, please include both VAT ID and the VAT registration country code. For US entities submit the W-9.
- Cutoffs: invoices submitted by 14:00 PST are included in the current payment run; anything after will be scheduled for the next run. Net terms will be per your contract (net 30 unless otherwise agreed).

I've attached a sanitized sample PO in JSON format (sample_po.json) and an example header mapping we use. Please validate your sample invoice against sample_po.json and let us know if any fields are missing. Once we receive the completed AP packet and the sample invoice, I'll kick off the vendor creation.

Kim — quick internal note before we finalize the packet: Acme's requirement for PO_NUMBER in header and PO_LINE_ID at row level is fine, but their "SPLIT_BY_LINE" boolean means our billing engine needs to set a metadata flag on upload. That will need a one-off mapping in our invoice exporter. I can add it to the Redwood_vendor_profile.xlsx export, but finance needs to approve enabling split-by-line by default (it changes how we batch invoices).

Marissa — can you confirm we are comfortable with split-by-line as the default behavior for Acme? If not, we should add a note saying "SPLIT_BY_LINE: true only when applicable" and raise with the payments queue.

Jordan
Finance Integration Lead
